name: The Juicy Blue U-Pick Berry Farm
description: In 206 Methodist Rd., OR, The Juicy Blue U-Pick Berry Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
